name: Money Lending
overview: Scripture instructs believers to lend money with compassion and integrity, especially to those in need, forbidding the charging of interest or usury among God's people as a demonstration of mercy and righteousness. Lending to the poor is portrayed as an act of kindness unto the Lord, who promises to repay such generosity. The righteous are characterized by their willingness to give and show mercy, contrasting with the wicked who borrow without repaying. These teachings emphasize lending as a means to uphold brotherly love and justice within the community.
